ambiguities_or_notes: The eight-line joking note is translated line-for-line without inventing an English rhyme scheme.
The nonstandard jocular self-name Толстова is represented as Tolstov rather than normalized to Tolstoy because it participates in the rhyme/wordplay with Molostvova.
All three embedded editorial notes are translated, including their alternate textual witnesses, dating argument, Ogolin biography, and quoted climbing anecdote.
The long footnote on Zinaida Molostvova is translated in full, with dates, institutions, family relations, and bibliography preserved.
The p. 102 marker occurs inside editorial note 2 in the source and is retained there.
